importReadiness.identity: ready: canonical official identity is Ekegården - Koarp, Södra delleden section 9 / official order 25, 13 km, medium/blue, no official walking time.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Ekegården the trail follows a mix of forest roads, country roads and natural paths across Smedjeån and Stensån. The middle of the section passes farms, glacially shaped hills and the Smedjeån sliprännor before the route crosses road 24 and heads toward Hallandsåsen. After the Klippebäcken stone bridge, beech forest and a steeper final climb lead to Koarp, where Hallandsleden ends and Skåneleden continues toward Brammarp.

importReadiness.campingFire: ready with dynamic caveats: Ekegården and Koarp shelters/camps are core official facilities; firewood/fireplace use depends on live fire-risk/fire-ban status.
